biggest_catch: The referred person must open BOTH a savings and a checking account (with $5 + $10 opening deposits) — if they only open one account type, the referral does not qualify.
catches: Referred member must open a savings AND a checking account; savings requires a $5 opening deposit and checking a $10 opening deposit (coupons may cover these — ask for details).
Referred person must be eligible for First City membership (lives, works, or worships in served LA County / San Bernardino County communities).
Bonus may be considered taxable income and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer subject to change without notice; cannot be combined with other offers; all applicant information subject to verification.

steps: Be an existing First City Credit Union member.
Sign the Member Referral Form with your name and member number.
Share the form with a friend, coworker, or relative who is eligible for First City membership.
Your referred person opens a new First City savings account ($5 opening deposit) plus a checking account ($10 opening deposit).
You earn $25 for each qualifying referral, paid immediately to your savings account upon their opening — no limit on referrals.
timing: Bonus paid immediately to the savings account upon the referred member opening the qualifying accounts.
when_cash_arrives: $25 paid immediately to your savings account the moment your friend opens the qualifying savings + checking accounts. No activity period, no card mailing - the payout triggers at account opening.
maximize: Fastest possible structure: have your friend open the savings and checking accounts online in a single sitting - the bonus fires at opening, not after a waiting period.
The friend must open BOTH account types - one alone does not qualify.
